attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1/node2/node3, Ubuntu 16.04) serving AMQP over TLS on port 5671, using a dedicated CA generated for this cluster. The AMQPS listener requires clients to present a certificate signed by that CA (verify_peer + fail_if_no_peer_cert). The plaintext AMQP listener is disabled. The management UI (port 15672) is bound to each node's private IP and firewalled via iptables to accept connections only from the three cluster node IPs. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time, with verified boot-identity changes and full post-restart cluster/data/TLS health.
